about: The pool table, one file the placer and the judge's reruns both read (workshop ~/.loom/pools.json, Fabric's). Each pool: its name on the wire, its tier (unit-needs.json's tiers), the runner its workers serve (a unit runs only where its key's keyParts.tools.runner is served), and each worker's memory and cpus. A unit whose declared need a pool can't hold never goes there.
